_comment: Scenarios testing service disambiguation (6 categories + massage duration variants + pilates group/private) at Ryde Health, a multi-modality clinic.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous massage — no duration stated, must ask

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a massage please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks '30, 45, 60, or 90 minute massage?' (or equivalent duration question) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls universal_router confirm_service without knowing the duration. FAIL if agent reads out the full service menu.

scenarios.name: Massage with duration stated upfront — direct confirm_service, no duration question

history.content: I'd like to book a 60 minute remedial massage.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='158226' and appointment_type='60 Minute Remedial Massage'. FAIL if agent asks the duration question when 60 minutes was already stated. FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase alongside the tool call.

scenarios.name: Pilates class vs private disambiguation — caller says 'pilates' only

history.content: I'd like to book a pilates session.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Would you like a group class or a private one-on-one session?' with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent assumes group and calls confirm_service immediately. FAIL if agent assumes private and calls confirm_service. FAIL if agent reads out full service menu.

scenarios.name: Service not offered — caller asks for yoga

history.content: Do you offer yoga classes?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent responds with NOT_OFFERED template listing the available services (Chinese Medicine and Acupuncture, Chiropractic, Osteopathy, Physiotherapy, Remedial Massage, Pilates and Strength and Conditioning) and asks if the caller would like one of those. FAIL if agent tries to book a yoga appointment. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service with a fabricated service ID.

scenarios.name: New vs existing gate for osteopathy with Deepak preference

history.content: I'd like to see Deepak for osteopathy.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Have you seen Deepak before?' (PRAC_VARIANT_SELF) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent skips the gate and calls confirm_service immediately. FAIL if agent uses the generic VARIANT_SELF ('Have you had Osteopathy with us before?') when a named practitioner was stated. FAIL if agent lists all practitioners or services.

scenarios.name: Pilates class direct shortcut — caller says 'pilates class'

history.content: I want to book a pilates class.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281' and appointment_type='Reformer & Studio Pilates Class (50 mins)' (no group/private question asked). FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or any ID other than '1946841739058742281'. FAIL if agent asks group or private question. FAIL if agent asks variant/new-patient question. FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase alongside the tool call.

scenarios.name: Pilates classes plural, first turn — must route to the live class type

history.content: Hi, I'm looking to join one of your pilates classes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281'. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or any other ID. FAIL if agent asks a group/private or new/returning question first.

scenarios.name: Strength and conditioning class, first turn — no dead ID, spoken notice only

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a strength and conditioning class.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the STRENGTH_CLASS_NOT_OFFERED template (says the clinic does not offer strength and conditioning classes at the moment, names Pilates classes and private one-on-one sessions as what it does have, and asks which the caller would like) with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if agent calls universal_router (any intent) with appointment_type_id '1340818859027858611' or any other ID. FAIL if agent speaks a filler phrase and calls confirm_service. FAIL if agent says or implies a strength and conditioning class can be booked.

scenarios.name: Strength class short phrasing, first turn — no dead ID, spoken notice only

history.content: Can I book a strength class please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the STRENGTH_CLASS_NOT_OFFERED template (no strength and conditioning classes at the moment; Pilates classes and private one-on-one sessions are available; asks which) with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if agent calls universal_router (any intent) with appointment_type_id '1340818859027858611' or any other ID.

scenarios.name: Reply to strength notice — caller picks the pilates class

history.content: I'd like to book a strength and conditioning class.
We don't offer strength and conditioning classes at the moment. We do have Pilates classes and private one-on-one sessions -- which would you like?
Okay, the pilates class then.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281'. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or '1340818859027858611'. FAIL if agent repeats the not-offered notice. FAIL if agent asks another question before routing.

scenarios.name: Reply to strength notice — caller picks a private one-on-one session

history.content: I'd like to book a strength and conditioning class.
We don't offer strength and conditioning classes at the moment. We do have Pilates classes and private one-on-one sessions -- which would you like?
One on one please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Checkpoint, Initial session, or Injury Rehab?' (or a close equivalent offering those three private sessions) with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service before the private session type is chosen. FAIL if agent repeats the not-offered notice.

scenarios.name: Class-only request — goes to the Pilates class, no strength question

history.content: I'd like to book a class.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281'. FAIL if agent asks 'Clinical Pilates or Strength and Conditioning?' or any group/private/strength question. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or '1340818859027858611'.

scenarios.name: Pilates then 'a group class' answer — GROUP PATH default routes to the Pilates class

history.content: I'd like to book some pilates.
Would you like a group class or a private one-on-one session?
A group class please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281'. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or any other ID. FAIL if agent asks 'Clinical Pilates or Strength and Conditioning?' or any other question before routing.

scenarios.name: group_or_private already 'group' — pilates routes straight to the Pilates class

history.content: I'd like to book pilates please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281'. FAIL if agent asks the group/private question (group_or_private is already set). FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '574353' or any other ID.

scenarios.name: Private path, initial session — routes to the Pilates Introduction Session

history.content: I'd like a private one-on-one pilates session.
Checkpoint, Initial session, or Injury Rehab?
Initial session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='2036894938632816220' (the $90 physio-led Pilates Introduction Session -- the prior free-promo ID 1690378981271930393 was retired 2026-09-23 as its promo pricing expires 2026-09-30). FAIL if the call uses any other appointment_type_id. FAIL if agent asks another question before routing.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic new patient with Joel Scott preference — routes to his $60 promo ID

history.content: I'd like to book with Joel Scott for chiropractic, I haven't been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='2013513066452354164' and appointment_type='$60 Extended First Consultation & Treatment with Chiropractor Dr Joel Scott', patient_status='new'. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '382287' or any other ID. FAIL if agent asks the generic new/existing gate question when the caller already stated they haven't been before.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic new patient with Thomas Gavros preference — routes to his $60 promo ID

history.content: Can I see Thomas Gavros for a chiro appointment? I'm a new patient.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='2013662749577446585' and appointment_type='$60 Extended First Consultation & Treatment with Chiropractor Dr Thomas Gavros', patient_status='new'. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '382287' or any other ID.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic new patient, no practitioner preference — generic ID unaffected

history.content: I'd like to book a chiropractic appointment, first time here.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='382287' (generic Initial Chiropractic Consultation). FAIL if the call uses '2013513066452354164' or '2013662749577446585' (practitioner-specific promo IDs) when no practitioner was named.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic existing patient with Joel Scott preference — generic Standard ID, not the promo

history.content: I've seen Joel Scott before for chiro, can I book with him again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='158223' (generic Standard Chiropractic Consultation), patient_status='existing'. FAIL if the call uses '2013513066452354164' (Joel's new-patient promo ID) for a returning patient.

scenarios.name: Pilates class for a child — routes to Tween & Teens Class

history.content: I want to book my daughter into a pilates class, she's 14.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='2036068889695094210' and appointment_type mentioning Tween & Teens. FAIL if the call uses appointment_type_id '1946841739058742281' (the adult class) for a stated child/teen booking. FAIL if agent asks the group/private question first (a class was already named).

scenarios.name: Adult pilates class request — unaffected by the new Tween & Teens branch

history.content: I'd like to book a pilates class for myself.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1946841739058742281' (the adult class). FAIL if the call uses '2036068889695094210' (Tween & Teens) when no child/teen was mentioned.
